clues.text: This coaster reaches a top height of 116 feet, hits speeds up to 47 mph, and sends riders through 6 inversion experiences.
Built by Dutch ride manufacturer Vekoma, this steel coaster made its official debut in 1999.
You can take a turn on this thrill ride in the state of Texas.
Located at Six Flags Fiesta Texas, this steel shuttle coaster received a brand new train for its 2023 season.
This coaster shares its name with the traditional Australian curved hunting tool that flies in an arc back to the person who threw it.
